teaser: Today, the Honourable Dominic LeBlanc, President of the King's Privy Council for Canada and Minister responsible for Canada-U.S. Trade, Intergovernmental Affairs, Internal Trade and One Canadian Economy and the Honourable Janice Charette, Canada's Chief Trade Negotiator to the United States, met with provincial and territorial ministers responsible for International Trade to discuss Canada-U.S. trade relations. Minister LeBlanc provided an update on the Joint Review of the Canada-United States-Mexico Agreement (CUSMA), following the trilateral meeting of the CUSMA Free Trade Commission held on July 1.
title: Minister LeBlanc updates provincial and territorial ministers responsible for International Trade on CUSMA Joint Review
